premises.text: Synthetic pesticides that control microbial spoilage are being banned as harmful, while natural waxes are hard to scale
premises.evidence_span: currently used pesticides are synthetic compounds, which are harmful to human beings and the environment, so they are being banned. And even though there are natural waxes available that might come from plant or insect compounds, scaling up these solutions is a real challenge

premises.text: Transparent, odorless, tasteless coatings from non-GMO fermented biomolecules protect produce without changing customer experience
premises.evidence_span: Our coatings are based on biomolecules produced by non-GMOs, which were isolated from nature. These coatings are transparent, odorless, and tasteless, so they don't alter the customer experience

premises.text: Fungal glucose biopolymer plus natural antimicrobials regulate gas exchange, delay ripening, and deliver low-dose antimicrobials in a washable edible matrix
premises.evidence_span: The coating is made of a glucose-based biopolymer produced by fungi and naturally occurring antimicrobials produced by different strains

premises.text: Citrus MVP matches common synthetic fungicide efficacy enabling zero-residue premium positioning; related formulas help berries and extend climacteric shelf life
premises.evidence_span: our formulation showed to be as effective as the most commonly used synthetic fungicide in citrus. And this means that our customers will be able to market their produce as zero chemical residues, capturing a price premium

premises.text: Cell-free formulations are stable and integrate with existing packing-line machinery without special equipment
premises.evidence_span: Our cell-free formulations are stable and can be easily stored

value.text: Fight food waste and insecurity by protecting produce without compromising human or planetary health
value.evidence_span: help fight against food waste and food insecurity without compromising human or planetary health

secondary_value.text: Zero chemical residues with price premium and decay control
secondary_value.evidence_span: market their produce as zero chemical residues, capturing a price premium and without compromising decay control

causal_links.evidence_span: harmful to human beings and the environment, so they are being banned
harness the power of microbial fermentation to protect our food
extend the shelf life of produce

notes: Food-waste GHG framing folded into value context / P1 need. Berry and avocado performance kept with citrus MVP as applications of same coating family (P4) rather than separate mechanisms. R&D agreements/field tests excluded as traction. Competitor contrast on living microbes informs P5 storage/stability claim.
